prerequisites: Basics of Materials Science and Metallurgy, i.e., having attended the course of Materials for Industrial Engineering.

learning_outcomes.text: The student will acquire the main competencies in terms of analysis of metallic materials.
The student will learn, through both frontal lessons and experimental laboratory activities, how to perform and analyze mechanical tests, thermal analyses, and metallographic analyses.

At the end of the course, the student must have learned how to perform these tests, based on which parameters they are chosen, with which criteria they are set up, and what are the critical aspects related to each of them.

syllabus_topics: Mechanical tests: tension, impact, hardness, fatigue, wear
Metallographic analysis: sample preparation, microstructural analysis, grain size measurement.
teaching_methods: Experimental group activity in the laboratory

assessment_methods.method: Presentation of experimental work, including data processing and discussion, and bibliographic research on the topic
Questions on laboratory activity and course topics

assessment_rules: The assessment consists of the presentation of the experimental work carried out in the laboratory, including the processing and discussion of the obtained data, as well as bibliographic research on the topic. The presentation will be followed by questions on both the laboratory activity and the topics covered during the course. The evaluation will result in a final grade.
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Industriale (Industrial Engineering), classe L-9 Classe delle lauree in Ingegneria industriale
